test_title: PYST 95: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 30 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
'A × B' means 'A is the father of B'

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B'

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the son of B'

'A - B' means 'A is the daughter of B'

How is A related to D in the expression 'A ÷ B + C × D'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Daughter 
 Father
 Son 
 
 

 

Given: A ÷ B + C × D

It means: A is the son of B, B is the mother of C and C is the father of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/646a9b120733f4a0d6a2c6c814e7b62dfc540c959a00d5ecd3df9d8a8a867ec7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b59e5439ee04cadc11d9f04339e6845497a3a3473e25b449524244c59ef1f545.png] 

So, A is the 'Father’s brother' of D.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
